items.headline: Sunnyvale to consider raising affordable housing fees
items.summary: The City Council is scheduled to hold a study session on increasing inclusionary housing requirements and updating below-market-rate in-lieu fees charged to new rental and ownership housing developments.

items.headline: Planning Commission to consider 8 homes replacing 1 house
items.summary: The Planning Commission is scheduled to consider a special development permit and subdivision map to demolish a single-family home at 781 S Wolfe Rd and build eight two-story single-family houses on the 0.57-acre site, with a floor area ratio of 65.8%.
